newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma backs anti-Yeltsin move in principle.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma backs anti-Yeltsin move in principle.

text.p: The State Duma lower house of the Russian parliament on Wednesday approved in principal a resolution aimed at forcing President Boris Yeltsin out of office on health grounds.

But deputies continued to discuss possible amendments which could change the substance of the motion. Pro-government deputy speaker Alexander Shokhin told the chamber that the legal status of the resolution was unclear.
